description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableFeatures' which implements the 'Features' interface, managing a collection of 'Feature' objects with various methods for manipulation and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatures
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Features interface managing a map of feature IDs to Feature instances with methods for manipulation and serialization.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty ImmutableFeatures instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableFeatures initialized with provided Feature instances.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the Feature for a given feature ID.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the specified Feature set or replaced.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the specified feature removed.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets a FeatureDefinition for a feature, replacing existing or creating new.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition from a specified feature.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property on a feature using a JsonPointer.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of features contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no features.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the features to a JsonObject, considering a schema version and predicate.
